datasets.name: CalcedDeposits
datasets.sql:
select 
 cont.id,
 cont.contractno,
 cont.opendate,
 cont.closedate, 
 dm_stored_programs.GetContractAccountName(acc.contractaccid) as custname,
 cstate.facticaldebt,
 dm_stored_programs.GetClientFacticalDebt(acc.clientaccid) as facticalinterestdebt,
 cint.interest,
 cont.interest contper,
 (case when  (cont.closedate>=sbop.get_date) or (cont.closedate=cont.opendate) or (cont.prolongationdate>=sbop.get_date) then cont.interest
       when  cont.closedate<sbop.get_date then cont.dueinterest end)precent,
 dm_stored_programs.CheckContractState(cont.ID) as  Status,
 av.val_name,
 cont.currency,
 cont.personaltype,
 cont.clienttype,
 cont.customerid,
 cont.branchid,
(select type from dm_types where id=cont.contracttype) as contype,
(case 
 when dm_stored_programs.GetDepType(capitalperid)='WITHDRAW' 
 then
  (select  description||'(Hesaba Köçür)' from dm_depcapitalperiods where id=capitalperid)
 when dm_stored_programs.GetDepType(capitalperid)='CAPITALIZATION'  
 then
  (select  description||'(Kapitallaşdırma)' from dm_depcapitalperiods where id=capitalperid) 
 
 when dm_stored_programs.GetDepType(capitalperid)='BEFOPERCENT' 
 then 
  (select  description||'(Müddətin əvvəli)' from dm_depcapitalperiods where id=capitalperid) 
end) 
as capitalname
from dm_contracts cont,
     dm_contract_accounts acc,
     dm_history_currstate cstate,
     dm_interest_currstate cint,
     avalute av
where cont.type# = 3
and acc.id# = cont.id
and cstate.id# = cont.id
and cint.id# = cont.id 
and cont.currency=av.valute
and cstate.facticaldebt>0
order by :OrderField

datasets.name: Customers
datasets.sql:
select id,name from customers
where id in (select customerid from sbcm_contracts
where type# = 3)
